ev.q: exquisitely accurate dialogue, capturing the feel of adolescence perfectly
Sitcom about a bunch of middle-class adolescent lads
his friends Simon Cooper (Joe Thomas), Neil Sutherland (Blake Harrison) and Jay Cartwright (James Buckley)
at the fictional Rudge Park Comprehensive
futile crushes, sibling brawls, getting drunk too quickly
originally aired on E4 from 2008 to 2010
